mainTopic: Which women are included in the סוטה process: finishing בית הלל's reasoning about the כתובה, and רב נחמן's rule that the argument about women who cannot have children does not include an אילונית
overview: This amud opens by finishing the explanation of בית הלל: a payment that is only 'about to be collected' is not treated as already collected. So a woman who cannot prove her innocence does not get her כתובה. The גמרא then goes back to the משנה's list of women who neither drink nor collect their כתובה. רב נחמן, quoting רבה בר אבוה, says the argument between the תנא קמא and רבי אלעזר is only about an עקרה and a זקינה. For an אילונית, everyone agrees she neither drinks nor collects, because the פסוק 'and she shall conceive seed' speaks of a woman who is naturally able to have children. The גמרא then starts a challenge from a ברייתא about a man who warns his ארוסה or his שומרת יבם. The part of the ברייתא that clashes with רב נחמן comes on the next amud.

steps.title: בית הלל: a debt waiting to be collected is not yet collected
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא finishes explaining בית הלל: a שטר that stands to be collected is not considered already collected. So the כתובה money is not treated as already hers.
steps.simpleTranslation: And בית הלל hold that a document that is waiting to be collected is not treated as if it were already collected.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא wraps up its explanation of why בית הלל say a woman who cannot drink also does not collect her כתובה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The כתובה money is still in the husband's (or his heirs') hands. בית הלל say a claim that is only waiting to be collected is not yet hers. So she is the one asking for money, and she cannot get it without proving she did nothing wrong.

keyTerms.meaning: The school of הלל, whose view here is the opposite of בית שמאי's
A legal document; here, a document of debt such as a כתובה
Standing to be collected: owed but not yet paid
It is considered as if already collected

steps.whatToRemember: בית הלל: 'about to be collected' does not count as 'collected.' So the woman counts as the claimant and must prove her case before she is paid.

phrases.english: a document that stands to be collected
phrases.notes: Think of the כתובה: the money is owed to her, but she hasn't received it yet.

phrases.english: is not considered as if it were already collected.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the earlier explanation, which gave בית שמאי's reasoning (a debt waiting to be collected counts as collected). This line gives the opposite reasoning for בית הלל.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to בית הלל, a debt that is waiting to be collected is not treated as collected. So the woman does not hold the כתובה money and cannot collect it.

steps.title: The argument covers only a barren woman and an elderly woman
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא cites the משנה about women who cannot drink. רב נחמן, quoting רבה בר אבוה, says the argument between the תנא קמא and רבי אלעזר applies only to an עקרה and a זקינה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: 'A woman pregnant with another man's child, etc.' רב נחמן said in the name of רבה בר אבוה: the argument is only about a barren woman and an elderly woman.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens a new topic by pointing back to a line in the משנה. רב נחמן then limits which cases the argument there covers.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה lists an אילונית, a זקינה and a woman who cannot give birth. The תנא קמא says they do not drink. רבי אלעזר says they do drink, because the husband can marry another wife and have children. רב נחמן says this argument covers only the עקרה and the זקינה, which quietly leaves the אילונית out of it.

keyTerms.meaning: A woman pregnant with another man's child
An elderly woman, past the age of having children

steps.confusionAlert: Don't assume the argument covers every woman on the משנה's list. רב נחמן says it covers only the עקרה and the זקינה, not the אילונית.

phrases.english: A woman pregnant with another's child, etc.
phrases.notes: 'כו׳' means 'and so on.' The גמרא is quoting the start of a line in the משנה (24a) and wants us to remember the rest.

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַב נַחְמָן אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר אֲבוּהּ:
phrases.english: Rav Naḥman said that Rabba bar Avuh said:
The dispute is about a barren woman and an elderly woman.
phrases.notes: He means the argument between the תנא קמא and רבי אלעזר in that משנה.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב נַחְמָן אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר אֲבוּהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new topic from the משנה, separate from the בית שמאי and בית הלל discussion.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The argument between the תנא קמא and רבי אלעזר is only about an עקרה and a זקינה.

steps.title: Everyone agrees an אילונית neither drinks nor collects
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן goes on: for an אילונית, everyone agrees she neither drinks nor collects her כתובה. The פסוק 'and she shall conceive seed' speaks of a woman who is normally able to have children.
steps.simpleTranslation: But an אילונית: everyone agrees she does not drink and does not collect her כתובה. As it says: 'And she shall be cleared, and shall conceive seed.' This means a woman whose nature is to have children. It leaves out this woman, whose nature is not to have children.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן finishes his rule: the אילונית is outside the argument. He brings a פסוק to show that the סוטה process is only for a woman who can have children.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תורה promises that an innocent סוטה will 'conceive seed.' That promise only makes sense for a woman who is naturally able to have children. An אילונית is physically unable to, so the פסוק leaves her out. Even רבי אלעזר would agree that she does not drink.

keyTerms.meaning: A woman who is physically underdeveloped and unable to have children
Her nature is to conceive and have children
Excluded; this case is left out

steps.whatToRemember: רב נחמן's rule: an עקרה or זקינה is the subject of the argument, but an אילונית never drinks and never collects, according to everyone. The source is 'וְנִזְרְעָה זָרַע.'
steps.whyThisMatters: This rule is what the coming ברייתא will be tested against, so keep the difference between an אילונית and an עקרה clearly in mind.

phrases.english: But a woman who cannot bear children (an ailonit),
everyone agrees she does not drink
and does not collect her marriage contract,
as it says: 'And she shall be cleared, and shall conceive seed,'
meaning one whose nature is to conceive,
which excludes this one, whose nature is not to conceive.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲבָל אַיְילוֹנִית דִּבְרֵי הַכֹּל לֹא שׁוֹתָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes רב נחמן's statement by saying what falls outside the argument and giving the source for it.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Everyone agrees an אילונית neither drinks nor collects her כתובה, because the סוטה process is for a woman who is naturally able to have children.

steps.title: A challenge begins from a ברייתא about a betrothed woman and a widow waiting for her יבם
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a ברייתא to challenge רב נחמן. If a man warns his ארוסה or his שומרת יבם, and she is secluded before he married her, she neither drinks nor collects her כתובה.
steps.simpleTranslation: They challenged him from a ברייתא: A man who warns his betrothed, or the widow waiting for him as her יבם, if she was secluded before he married her, she does not drink and does not collect her כתובה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts quoting a ברייתא in order to challenge רב נחמן. This is only the opening of the ברייתא; the part that actually clashes with רב נחמן comes on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first case in the ברייתא is a woman who was only betrothed, or waiting for יבום, and was secluded before the marriage was completed. She neither drinks nor collects. This part prepares the challenge; the ברייתא will go on to say something that seems to contradict רב נחמן's rule about the אילונית.

keyTerms.meaning: They raised an objection, usually from a תנאי source
One who warns his wife not to be alone with a certain man (קינוי)
His betrothed, who is not yet fully married to him
A widow waiting for her late husband's brother to do יבום
She was secluded with the other man (סתירה)

steps.confusionAlert: The clash with רב נחמן is not visible yet. This first case of the ברייתא is setup, and the real problem comes on the next amud.

phrases.english: or his widow awaiting him as her yavam,
if she was secluded before he married her,
phrases.notes: 'Married' here means he actually brought her into his home as his wife, beyond just the betrothal.

phrases.english: she does not drink and does not collect her marriage contract.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a ברייתא-based challenge to רב נחמן's rule from steps 2 and 3.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב נחמן's claim that the argument covers only the עקרה and זקינה, and that everyone agrees about the אילונית
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The ברייתא is being quoted to show a תנאי source that disagrees with רב נחמן's rule. Only the opening case is quoted on this amud, and the conflicting detail comes on the next amud.
